spanish: Y quitó la rueda de sus carros, y lo condujo en pesadez, y dijo Egipto: Huya de faces de Israel, porque Jehová pelea a ellos en Egipto.

findings.issue: Cohortative 1st common singular (the speaker’s own volitive to flee); Huya is an usted command or 3rd-person subjunctive, shifting person and participant.

notes: Remaining clauses match the packet’s number, suffixes, singular wheel, plural chariots, and locked names.
